title: Release Content Profile (release-profile/v1)
description: XACA-1342 / spec docs/release-workflow/RELEASE-LIFECYCLE.md § 11.3, reconciled against the Main Event CR seed (docs/release-workflow/PROFILE-MAIN-EVENT-CR-SEED/cr/profile.json, XCMD-0018-007). The seed's actual field shapes diverge from § 11.3's placeholder (nested objects instead of flat strings in several places); this schema models the seed's shapes and accepts the spec's flat-string forms as sugar where noted below. Nothing at the top level is required: this schema validates the SHAPE of whichever fields a profile carries, per the 'never restate a count -- verify against the fixture' spirit of the ticket -- a profile kind (cr/testing-log/cr-record/notice) is free to omit fields it doesn't use. additionalProperties is open at the top level (seed carries provenance metadata this schema does not need to check: $schema value 'seed-only', docType, team, seedSource, subjectPerspective, titleWordCount, titleSourceRule, releaseTypes, notifySourceRule) and closed inside every validated sub-object below.

$schema.description: Not constrained to a const here: the seed's own profile.json carries the literal value 'seed-only — not validated against Academy's real schema...' rather than 'release-profile/v1'. Left as an open string so the seed fixture is not rejected on this field.

docType.description: Seed-only alternate spelling of 'kind' carried as provenance; not cross-checked against kind.

detailLevel.description: § 11.3 placeholder shows an enum (summary|standard|detailed); the seed's real value is free prose ('minimal — the whole CR should read in under a minute'), so this is modeled as an open string rather than the placeholder's enum.

requiredSections.description: § 11.3 placeholder is a flat string array. The seed uses richer objects per section. A flat string is accepted as sugar for {id: <string>, label: <string>, required: true}.

fixedValue.description: Seed shape is an object of fixed field->value strings, but left type-open since it is opaque template data, not something this schema enforces the shape of.

bannedTokenPatterns.description: § 11.3 placeholder is a flat regex-string array. The seed uses richer objects. A flat string is accepted as sugar for {pattern: <string>, reason: ""}.

linkPolicy.description: § 11.3 placeholder shape {allowed, maxLinks} is accepted, but is not expressive enough for the seed's maxCount-bounded required links -- the seed's richer {defaultAllowLinks, standardLinks[], supersedesException, everythingElseBanned} shape is modeled directly and also accepted.

requireLeadDraftApproval.description: § 11.3 spec-compatible flat form. Read only from the cr kind.

draftApproval.description: Seed-compatible richer form. When present, requireLeadDraftApproval is derived as draftApproval.required.

approval.description: Read only from the cr kind. Provider-specific fields beyond 'provider' vary (manual vs. assumed-schedule per § 9.1) and are left open.

wikiDocType.description: § 11.3 spec-compatible flat form. When absent, derived from wiki.docType.

wiki.description: Seed-compatible nested form. wikiDocType derives from wiki.docType when present.

excludedFromScope.description: Business-policy filter for guest-facing scope (XACA-1343 owns the rendering behavior; this schema accepts the shape and constrains action to the values the engine accepts, XACA-1366).

action.description: Exact, case-sensitive: fold counts excluded items into a summary line; omit drops them silently. Matches release_fact_dictionary._EXCLUDED_ACTIONS.
